{"text":"Hello {first_name},

This is {clinic_name}. We would like to see you for a follow-up visit. Please book by {due_by}.

It is easy to set up. Just call us at {clinic_phone}, and we will find a time that works for you.

We look forward to seeing you soon.

If you do not want these reminders, you can stop them here: {opt_out_link}

Warmly,
{clinic_name}"}
